title: RAG with Semantic Kernel
description: Build a RAG pipeline using Semantic Kernel in C# with text memory, retrieval, and grounded generation.

blocks.text: Semantic Kernel provides memory stores, retrieval configurations, and plugins that simplify RAG. You can ingest documents, search memory, and ground answers without building the pipeline from scratch.
Key Semantic Kernel Concepts for RAG

blocks.title: Relevant abstractions
items: **Text memory** — stores embeddings and metadata with pluggable stores.
**Retrieval configuration** — controls search behavior, including top-k and relevance threshold.
**Plugins** — reusable tools or data access components that agents can call.
**Process framework** — orchestrates multi-step RAG or agent workflows.

blocks.title: Start with a memory store
blocks.text: Use a local or in-memory text store while learning. Move to persistent stores like Azure AI Search or Qdrant once the pipeline works.

blocks.title: Build a Semantic Kernel RAG Sample
blocks.description: Create a small .NET console or API project that ingests documents and answers questions with Semantic Kernel.
steps: Create a new project and install Semantic Kernel.
Ingest a Markdown document collection into text memory.
Ask questions and inspect the retrieved passages and final answers.
blocks.expectedOutcome: You should see retrieved chunks alongside generated answers, confirming the RAG pipeline is working end to end.
